c74object.name: j.textslider
c74object.digest: Slider with a text and a value display
c74object.description: A horizontal slider that shows a text and, while the mouse is over it, its value. A click or a drag changes the value; with the Command key the values are whole numbers, with the Shift key the drag is fine, and a double click with the Control key gives defaultvalue. Its colors follow the Max theme unless you set them.

outlet.description: The value of the slider, a decimal number.

method.name: bang
method.description: Sends the value out of the outlet.

method.name: int
method.description: Keeps the number, sends it out of the outlet (as a decimal number) and draws it. A value outside the range is output as it is and drawn at the end of the slider.

method.name: set
method.description: Keeps the number and draws it, without sending it out.

method.name: paint
method.description: Sent by Max when the slider is drawn.

method.name: mousedown
method.description: A click; with clickjump on, the value moves to the position of the mouse.

method.name: mousedoubleclick
method.description: A double click with the Control key gives defaultvalue.

method.name: mouseenter
method.description: The mouse arrives: the value is shown if showvalue is on.

method.name: mouseleave
method.description: The mouse leaves: the text is shown.

attribute.name: bgcolor
attribute.description: The color of the background. At its default it follows the Max theme (live_control_bg); a color you set is used as it is, and the attribute name without values gives the default back.

attribute.name: fgcolor
attribute.description: The color of the bar. At its default it follows the Max theme (live_selection, adjusted so that the text can be read on it); a color you set is used as it is, and the attribute name without values gives the default back.

attribute.name: bordercolor
attribute.description: The color of the border. At its default it follows the Max theme (live_control_bg); a color you set is used as it is, and the attribute name without values gives the default back.

attribute.name: textcolor
attribute.description: The color of the text. At its default it follows the Max theme (live_control_fg, or black or white where that is hard to read); a color you set is used as it is, and the attribute name without values gives the default back.

attribute.name: knobcolor
attribute.description: The color of the line at the end of the bar. At its default it follows the Max theme (live_value_bar, or the text color where that is hard to see); a color you set is used as it is, and the attribute name without values gives the default back.

attribute.name: range
attribute.description: The lowest and highest value of the slider (default 0 1); the two are swapped if the second is smaller.

attribute.name: text
attribute.description: The text shown on the slider.

attribute.name: textpos
attribute.description: Where the text starts: pixels from the left and from the top (default 10 4).

attribute.name: unit
attribute.description: The unit shown after the value.

attribute.name: showvalue
attribute.description: When on (the default), the value is shown instead of the text while the mouse is over the slider.

attribute.name: tracking
attribute.description: Which movement of the mouse moves the value: horizontal (the default), vertical or both (the larger one).

attribute.name: clickjump
attribute.digest: Jump to the value on a click
attribute.description: When on (the default), a click moves the value to the position of the mouse.

attribute.name: defaultvalue
attribute.description: The value that a double click with the Control key gives (default 0).
